region_label: Puget Sound — Pierce, King, Kitsap, Thurston Counties
notes: Puget Sound region. American Lake VA (Tacoma) is the primary VAMC for Pierce County veterans including JBLM. Seattle VA serves King and north counties. Major military presence: JBLM (Pierce), Naval Base Kitsap (Kitsap), McChord Field. 20-year retirees from JBLM/McChord are a core population here — TAP and retiree services available on-base. Washington's veteran population is among the highest per-capita nationally. Data current as of 2026 — verify contacts before production deployment.

providers.name: VA Puget Sound — American Lake Division
providers.notes: Primary VAMC for Pierce County including JBLM veterans. Located near Fort Lewis/McChord. Same-day mental health and crisis services. Patient Advocate on-site. The American Lake division specifically handles south Puget Sound and JBLM population.

providers.name: Tacoma Vet Center
providers.notes: VA-affiliated Vet Center. No VA enrollment required — walk-in eligible. Readjustment counseling, combat veteran and MST survivor support. Serves active duty, veterans, and their families. Key first-contact for JBLM veterans avoiding the formal VA system.

providers.name: Pierce County Veterans Services
providers.notes: County-funded VSO. Free VA claims assistance and accredited representation for Pierce County veterans. First stop for new claims, appeals, and benefits questions.
verify_before_production: Pierce County VSO direct phone — check piercecountywa.gov/veterans or call county main line

providers.name: King County Veterans Program
providers.notes: County-funded VSO. King County has one of the largest veteran populations in WA. Benefits navigation, emergency financial assistance, and housing coordination.
verify_before_production: King County Veterans Program direct line — check kingcounty.gov/veterans

providers.name: WDVA — Puget Sound Regional Office
providers.notes: Washington Department of Veterans Affairs regional presence. Accredited representatives. Statewide line 1-800-562-2308 routes to the appropriate regional office.

providers.name: JBLM Army Community Service (ACS)
providers.notes: On-base transition resource for JBLM. TAP program and SkillBridge for separating soldiers. Strong transition infrastructure — one of the best-resourced installations in the country. Access coordination required for non-active-duty. Also serves 20-year retirees transitioning out.
verify_before_production: JBLM ACS main line — check jblm.armymwr.com

providers.name: DAV — Puget Sound Area
providers.notes: DAV chapters active in Pierce and King counties. Free claims assistance and DAV transport program (DAVTS) for medical appointments. Use dav.org chapter locator for nearest chapter.
verify_before_production: Use dav.org chapter locator — Pierce and King counties

providers.name: SSVF Grantees — Tacoma / Pierce County
providers.notes: SSVF (Supportive Services for Veteran Families) rapid re-housing and homelessness prevention. Pierce County has active SSVF grantees. Route through VA American Lake social work or call National Homeless Veterans line (1-877-4AID-VET) to identify current grantees serving this area.
